Order
Dated this the 15 th  day of January , 2024

This  Crl.M.C.,

under  Section  482  of Cr.P.C.,
is filed by  accused  Nos.1  to  3  in C r i m e  N o . 1 0 1 3  o f  2 0 2 2  o f  C h i t t u r  Police Station,
Palakkad,
registered under Section 498A r/w Section 34 of IPC,
for quashing Annexure A1,
final report in  C.C.No.30 of  2023  on  the  file  of  Judicial  First  Class  Magistrate Court, Chittur. 
2.

The  prosecution  allegation  is  that, 
accused  Nos.1  to  3, 
who  are  the husband  and  in-laws  of  the  defacto  complainant/2 nd  respondent,

subjected  her  to  matrimonial  cruelties, demanding more gold and money. 
3.

When  the  matter  is  taken  up  for  consideration, 
learned  counsel  for the  petitioners  submitted  that  the  matter  stands  settled  between themselves  and  the  2 nd  respondent-defacto  complainant. 
The  defacto complainant  entered  appearance  through  counsel, 
and  submitted  that the matter is settled,
and Annexure A3 is the affidavit filed  by  her,

endorsing  the  settlement.

She has no intention to CRL.MC NO.7955 OF 2023  3   
proceed  with  the  prosecution.
She  has  no  objection  in  quashing the  proceedings  pending  against  the  petitioners  pursuant  to  Crime No.1013  of  2022  of  Chittur  Police  Station.

4. 
On  instructions, 
learned Public  Prosecutor  submitted  that  the  matter  is  settled, 
and  produced her  signed  statement to the effect that she is not intending to proceed with the prosecution,
and she has no objection in quashing  Annexure A1 f i n a l r e p o r t i n C . C . N o . 3 0 o f 2 0 2 3 .   5 .

Since the matter stands settled,
no purpose would be  served  by continuing  the  prosecution  against  the  petitioners.

6. 
In  the  light  of the  principles  laid  down  by  the  Apex  Court  in  Gian  Singh  v. 
State  o f  
 P u n j a b  
 a n d  
 A n o t h e r ;


[(2012)
10 SCC 303)]
,
and State of Madhya Pradesh  v. 
Laxmi Narayan  and  Others; 
[(2019) 
5  SCC  688], 
this  Court  is  of  the view  that the proceedings against the  petitioners  can  be  quashed  on t h e   b a s i s   o f   s e t t l e m e n t .  C R L . M C N O . 7 9 5 5 O F 2 0 2 3    4

In  the  result,

is  allowed  and  Annexure  A1 final  report  in  C.C.No.30  of  2023  on  the file of Judicial  First Class Magistrate Court, Chittur, stands quashed.
